svg.text: Canonical draw.io C4 roles: dark blue Person, blue System, cyan Container, light cyan Component, muted violet external System. Mermaid glyphs adapt the native assets.
Capsule adapts the person glyph. Plain rectangles adapt application glyphs. Cylinders are typed logical stores, including a Kafka topic.
Gray dashed frame = software-system boundary. Arrows = named dependencies with protocols. The compact companion legend must remain visible with the diagram/export.
Sizes accommodate content and carry no extra architectural meaning. Neutral relationship colors add no extra meaning. Arrowheads indicate the labeled direction.
Exact C4 shapes require the native draw.io companion; Mermaid syntax cannot import the native assets.
C4 visual reference: Simon Brown - c4model.com - CC BY 4.0 - Adapted
